evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `ci/test/` scripts to enable IPC in the i686 CI job.
rationale: Enables IPC coverage on 32-bit x86 CI to catch compiler ABI issues. The commit message notes this exercises IPC on 32-bit x86 'where compiler ABI differences have caused failures', providing worthwhile platform test coverage without addressing an active release-blocking build failure.
